title: bifurcation-1d widget params
description: A self-contained 'turn the bifurcation dial' engine for one-parameter families of 1-D flows x' = f(x; mu). The reader picks a normal form from a dropdown and drags a vertical mu-line across the bifurcation diagram (the dial gesture); the engine root-finds the fixed points of f(x; mu)=0 at every mu (sign-change bracketing + bisection), classifies each as stable (df/dx < 0) or unstable (df/dx > 0), and renders two linked panels: (top) the bifurcation diagram x* vs mu with stable branches solid-green and unstable branches dashed-pink, and (bottom) the live phase line at the current mu — fixed points as filled (stable) / hollow (unstable) dots with flow arrows showing the sign of f between them. The readout names the fixed points, their stability, and flags the bifurcation as mu crosses the critical value. The cases (normal forms) are param-driven via author JS expressions in x and mu; the renderer owns the root-finding, stability test, diagram, phase line, drag gesture, and readout. The gesture is 'dial' — dragging a parameter value and watching the qualitative phase portrait change, a dimension the corpus otherwise lacks. jsdom-safe: createSVGPoint/getScreenCTM run only inside the pointer handlers, never at init.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper.

svgId.description: DOM id for the <svg> drawing surface (both panels).

outputId.description: DOM id for the .readout the engine writes the fixed points / stability into.

selectId.description: DOM id for the <select> normal-form picker.

hint.description: Optional hint in .hd > .hint. Should tell the reader to pick a form and drag the mu-line.

svgTitle.description: Accessible <title> inside the SVG. Defaults to title.

xmin.description: Smallest x (state) shown / scanned for roots. Default -2.2.

muVar.description: Symbol shown for the parameter in the readout/axis. Default the Greek mu.

cases.description: The normal forms offered in the dropdown. Each gives a label, a JS expression `expr` in `x` and `mu` for f(x; mu), and the mu-window [mu0, mu1] with an optional initial/critical mu.

label.description: Dropdown label, e.g. 'saddle-node:  x' = mu - x^2'. Plain text (no LaTeX $) so the native <option> renders it.

expr.description: A JavaScript expression (NOT LaTeX or Python) for f(x; mu) in terms of the variables `x` and `mu`, evaluated with Math.* in scope — e.g. 'mu - x*x', 'mu*x - x*x', 'mu*x - x*x*x', 'mu*Math.sin(x) - x'. Compiled with new Function at render time; author/build-time content only, never runtime user input.

muInit.description: Initial mu (defaults to the midpoint of [mu0, mu1]).

muCrit.description: Optional critical mu where the bifurcation occurs (for the readout flag). Usually 0.
